selection_design: Purposive proposition/risk audit, not a random sample or claim-error-rate estimate. Registered after reading revised narrative and catalog metadata but before reopening original source passages in R2. Prior R1 knowledge is retained. Source IDs will be corrected transparently if catalog mapping differs; no adverse/successful result substitution.

selection.topic: Later household-textile persistence, refusal and positive counterevidence

selection.topic: Complementary maintenance demand versus gendered entry and actual cohort transitions

navigation_scope: Screen all 88 case titles/periods/regions, verify route membership/IDs and compare 9 route descriptions with periods; substantive actor/episode reading focused on selected case records.
other_scope: Read all 8 SYN comparisons, selected linked local comparisons, all revised synthesis/role/selection/map/uncertainty/hypothesis narrative. Check SP01–SP07 against exact revised records and downstream exports. UI outside scope. No certification of all 329 claims.
independence: Do not read other R2 reviewer findings or edit live research/frozen target. Cached original sources allowed with recorded paths, hashes and versions.
